findings.issue: «lleno de sus puños hollín» follows the construct order, but Spanish «lleno de» reads as an adjective and makes the hands the contents; מְלֹא חָפְנֵיכֶם is the fill measured by the hands, and פִּיחַ is the material.

notes: 2mp take and the 2mp suffixes stay with ustedes; only Moisés throws.
